content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.076 ([M+H]⁺). Subtracting the proton gives a neutral mass of ~210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base), characteristic of a single chlorine atom (⁷⁵Cl/⁷⁷Cl). Accounting for Cl (35.969 Da) leaves ~174.10 Da to be composed of C, H, and O. A formula that fits this mass and the observed 13C pattern (≈10 % M+1, consistent with ~10 carbons) is C₁₀H₇O₃Cl, whose exact monoisotopic mass (210.069 Da) matches the measured value. Therefore the molecular formula is C10H7O3Cl.
